e-4388.knowledge_point: Determining the Dimensions of the Transpose of a Matrix
e-4388.problem:
Consider the matrix
    ${B} = 
    \left\lbrack
    \matrix {
        1 & 2 & 4 & 2\
        4 & 4 & 1 & 1\
        3 & -3 & 0 & -1
    }
    \right\rbrack.$
What are the dimensions of ${B}^T?$
e-4388.worked_solution:
When a matrix is transposed, its dimensions switch from $N \times M$ to $M \times N.$

So, since $B$ is a $3 \times 4$ matrix, the transpose ${B}^T$ is a $4\times3$ matrix.
